verdict: A very close, well-placed rebuild of the Explore feed whose main weakness is the type rendering (fallback font with loose, uneven letter spacing that widens every line) plus a few off-glyph icons; cleanly structured with flex and templates.

top_defects.where: whole feed (event texts, Top read rows, tab labels, segmented control)
top_defects.what: SF Pro not rendered as in the capture: tracking looser and uneven (gaps in 'Foot balleur', 'souter rain', 'présidentielle'), lines run ~15-20 px (@3x) wider; segmented-control labels and tab labels visibly wider

top_defects.where: top bar profile button and tab bar
top_defects.what: profile is an outlined circle-user (Lucide) instead of the filled SF person.crop.circle; Home is a rounded Material house without the SF roof/door shape; Saved bookmark squatter than the reference's tall ribbon

top_defects.where: 'Which came first?' header and Top read #3 thumbnail
top_defects.what: calendar is Material calendar_month (rings, rounded) instead of the app's flat calendar glyph; Star Academy logo cropped/scaled differently behind the tab bar

top_defects.where: 'Which came first?' event rows and tab bar
top_defects.what: event text line height ~20.5 pt makes the second line and Nixon row sit ~2-3 pt lower; tab bar icons/labels ~1 pt lower than reference
selected Home uses #3366cc instead of #2975bf; capsule is near-opaque white/95 so the feed (row 2 thumbnail and subtitle) does not show through as in the Liquid Glass reference
dots colored by a CSS filter chain (invert/sepia/hue-rotate) on an img rather than a real colored icon; tab selection styling injected through a class string in template data
section header and card shell duplicated by hand with identical arbitrary values (shadow, radius, colors repeated, 174 arbitrary values) instead of one template/component

strengths: Every block of the screen is present at nearly the exact position: status bar, top bar pills, segmented control, Today, Card hidden banner, both cards and the floating tab bar + search button
Colors follow the measured palette (#202122, #72777d, #3366cc, #f8f9fa, #ececed) and real assets (W logo, map, Nixon, Pagis) are correctly cropped
Repeated rows (events, top read articles, tab items) are templates with data, inside flex columns that reflow
